verdict.rationale: Snyk's MCP integration is documented and probed exclusively as Snyk providing its own MCP server (security-scanning tools) for AI coding agents/IDEs to plug into (snyk-docs-28, snyk-probe-3, snyk-probe-6) — Snyk acts as the tool provider (server), not as a host/client that plugs external MCP servers into itself to gain their tools. This story's axis (product consuming other MCP servers as a client) is a category mismatch for a security-scanning product whose role in the MCP ecosystem is server-side.
